column3: GET /blobs/<sha256> serves stored bytes from the Worker behind the upload's owner check, instead of a DO route
column4: Thumbnails of sent messages will need bytes the owner already may read (no screen calls the route until the transcript wiring after #30); going through the home would cost a DO request per image, the Worker route costs one R2 get (and one auth call only for a rotated token)
column5: attachments.test.ts asserts 200 with the bytes and 401 for a bad token
